## Salesforce, Inc. (CRM) — Buy

Salesforce presents a compelling combination of business quality and valuation that is rare in large-cap SaaS: a 38.6% FCF margin with an EV/FCF of just 10.07x is genuinely cheap for a company with 77.6% gross margins and a Rule of 40 score of 51.9, suggesting the market is pricing this as a mature, slow-growth utility rather than the dominant CRM infrastructure it actually is. The 2.38x Net Debt/EBITDA is manageable and not a concern at this FCF generation level, though the absence of a reported ROIC figure warrants a closer look at capital allocation discipline, particularly given the company's history of large acquisitions. **Investment Takeaway:** At 10x FCF with 38%+ margins and entrenched enterprise switching costs, Salesforce is priced like a melting business but operates like a structurally essential one — the valuation alone makes this a high-conviction Buy.
